subject: math.GT
name: Jordan curve theorem
statement: A simple closed curve in the plane has a complement with exactly two connected components, one bounded and one unbounded. The curve is the boundary of each component.

subject: math.GT
name: Jordan–Schoenflies theorem
statement: Every simple closed curve in the plane is the image of the unit circle under a homeomorphism of the plane. In particular, its bounded complementary component together with the curve is homeomorphic to a closed disk.

subject: math.GT
name: Classification of closed surfaces
statement: Every closed connected surface is homeomorphic to a sphere, a connected sum of g tori for a unique g ≥ 1, or a connected sum of k real projective planes for a unique k ≥ 1. The first two types are orientable and the third type is nonorientable.

subject: math.GT
name: Seifert–van Kampen theorem
statement: If a space is the union of two path-connected open subsets whose intersection is nonempty and path-connected, its fundamental group is the pushout of their fundamental groups over the fundamental group of their intersection, using a common base point.

subject: math.GT
name: Mayer–Vietoris theorem
statement: For a space covered by two open subsets U and V, singular homology fits into a natural long exact sequence relating the homology of U ∩ V, U and V, and U ∪ V. The map out of Hₖ(U ∩ V) is induced by the two inclusions with opposite signs.

subject: math.GT
name: Poincaré duality
statement: For a closed connected oriented n-manifold, cap product with its integral fundamental class gives an isomorphism from Hᵏ(M;ℤ) to Hₙ₋ₖ(M;ℤ) for every k.

subject: math.GT
name: Lefschetz fixed-point theorem
statement: A continuous self-map of a compact polyhedron with nonzero Lefschetz number has a fixed point. The Lefschetz number is the alternating sum of the traces induced on rational homology.

subject: math.GT
name: Invariance of dimension
statement: If nonempty open subsets of Euclidean m-space and Euclidean n-space are homeomorphic, then m = n.

subject: math.GT
name: Generalized Poincaré theorem
statement: Every closed topological n-manifold homotopy equivalent to the n-sphere is homeomorphic to that sphere. This holds in every positive dimension; it does not assert uniqueness of smooth structures.

subject: math.GT
name: Smooth h-cobordism theorem
statement: A compact simply connected smooth h-cobordism of dimension at least six is diffeomorphic to a product with an interval, relative to either specified boundary component. An h-cobordism is a cobordism for which both boundary inclusions are homotopy equivalences.

subject: math.GT
name: Smooth s-cobordism theorem
statement: A compact smooth h-cobordism of dimension at least six is diffeomorphic to a product relative to one boundary component if and only if its Whitehead torsion vanishes.

subject: math.GT
name: Geometrization theorem
statement: Every closed orientable three-manifold admits a prime decomposition, and each prime factor can be cut along incompressible tori into pieces whose interiors admit complete locally homogeneous geometric structures from Thurston's eight three-dimensional geometries.

subject: math.GT
name: Dehn's lemma
statement: If a simple closed curve in the boundary of a three-manifold is null-homotopic in the manifold, it bounds a properly embedded disk in that manifold.

subject: math.GT
name: Loop theorem
statement: If the fundamental-group homomorphism from a boundary component of a three-manifold to the manifold is not injective, there is a properly embedded disk whose boundary lies in that component and is not null-homotopic in it.

subject: math.GT
name: Sphere theorem
statement: If an orientable three-manifold has nonzero second homotopy group, it contains an embedded two-sphere whose map into the manifold represents a nonzero element of that group.

subject: math.GT
name: Prime decomposition theorem for three-manifolds
statement: Every closed connected orientable three-manifold is a connected sum of finitely many prime three-manifolds. After omitting three-sphere summands, the prime factors are unique up to order and homeomorphism.

subject: math.GT
name: Alexander's braid theorem
statement: Every oriented link in the three-sphere is isotopic to the closure of a braid.

subject: math.GT
name: Markov's theorem
statement: Two braids have isotopic oriented link closures in the three-sphere if and only if they are related by braid conjugation and positive or negative stabilization or destabilization.

subject: math.GT
name: Reidemeister theorem
statement: Two diagrams represent ambient-isotopic links if and only if a finite sequence of planar isotopies and the three types of Reidemeister moves transforms one diagram into the other.

subject: math.GT
name: Lickorish–Wallace theorem
statement: Every closed connected orientable three-manifold can be obtained by integral Dehn surgery on a framed link in the three-sphere.
